Krishna swore He'd never lift a weapon, then broke His own promise. Stay till the end, the reason is beautiful.
As the story goes, in the great war, old Bhishma was unstoppable, and Arjuna couldn't fight his grandfather with his full heart. But Bhishma had vowed to make Krishna pick up a weapon.
So Krishna leapt off the chariot, lifted a broken wheel, and ran at Bhishma. Wait, why would God break His word?
Bhishma dropped his bow and smiled. Krishna broke His own promise to keep His devotee's. That's why we say God bends for His devotee. Comment Keshava, and send this to someone who keeps their word.
